An untitled action-adventure '''''Star Wars''''' video game is under development by [[Lucasfilm Games]]<ref name="Announcement" /> and [[Paramount Games Studio]], previously knows as Skydance New Media.<ref name="Variety" /> The game was announced on [[April 19]], [[2022]]. Skydance New Media President [[Amy Hennig]] will be directing the project.<ref name="Announcement" /> On [[June 5]], [[2023]], [[Dominic Robilliard]] said that he had joined the project.<ref name="Robilliard" />

On [[June 5]], [[2026]], [[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']] confirmed the game was still in development.<ref name="Variety" />
